mentions.name: Generative AI Review
mentions.description: A review website for Generative AI, targeted at people who want to use GenAI to build things. It features side-by-side comparisons of GenAI outputs, such as OpenAI's gpt-image-1 image generation quality across Low/Medium/High settings on challenging prompts.
